description: This file implements a PHP class 'HTTP_Session_Container_MDB2' which acts as a database container for session data, utilizing the PEAR MDB2 database abstraction layer. It provides methods for connecting to the database, reading, writing, destroying, and garbage collecting session data, specifically designed to handle session persistence in a database using MDB2.

classes.name: HTTP_Session_Container_MDB2
classes.description: A class that manages session data storage in a database using MDB2. It offers methods to open, close, read, write, destroy, and perform garbage collection on sessions.

methods.name: HTTP_Session_Container_MDB2
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the container with options, setting defaults and parsing provided options.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database using the provided DSN or MDB2 object.

methods.name: _setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default options for the database connection and table name.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a session storage, establishing a database connection.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the session storage (no actual resource cleanup needed).

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads session data from the database by session ID.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes session data into the database, updating existing records or inserting new ones.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes session data from the database by session ID.

methods.name: replicate
methods.description: Copies session data to another table, optionally.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection by deleting expired sessions and optionally optimizing the table.
